title: pomona v2
subtitle: AI/CV-driven PWA
text: Pomona V2 is an advanced plant identification app that utilizes AI and computer vision (CV) technologies to help users identify and learn about various plant species. Pomona V2 is developed as a Progressive Web App (PWA), making it accessible across multiple platforms without the need for installation.
description: The app aims to combine the power of PlantNet's plant identification capabilities with computer vision for easier and more accurate plant recognition. By leveraging AI and CV technologies, Pomona V2 seeks to provide users with a seamless experience in identifying and learning about various plant species.
